يستحيون (form X)
# يَسْتَحْيُونَ (yastaḥyūna) /jas.taħ.juː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَحْيَا (istaḥyā)
# يُسْتَحْيَوْنَ (yustaḥyawna) /jus.taħ.jaw.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَحْيَا (istaḥyā)
